title: Great Dying: Jab Samundar Ke 10 Me Se 8-9 Tarah Ke Jeev Khatam Ho Gaye | Mass Extinction
description:
Lagbhag 25 crore saal pehle dharti par ek aisi tabahi hui jise scientists The Great Dying kehte hain. Ye video simple Hindi me samjhata hai ki wo kya thi, hum kaise jaante hain, aur kya aaj se iska koi lena-dena hai.

Is video me: Permian ki dunia, 96% wale number ka sahi matlab (samundar ki 81 se 96 percent kismein), patthar ki parton aur ash se umar nikalna, Siberia ka lava, garmi, kam oxygen, khatta paani aur ozone, bach jaane wala Lystrosaurus, aur aaj ke haalat ka sirf wo hissa jo studies kehti hain.

Note: ye hamara hisaab hai, scientists ka tay number nahi: hamara hisaab: lava layer (India par lagbhag 1 km), 1.5 second (24 ghante ki film me), 4-19 per 100.

Sources (papers, press pages): Burgess, Bowring and Shen 2014 (PNAS); Burgess and Bowring 2015 (Science Advances); Burgess, Muirhead and Bowring 2017 (Nature Communications, USGS); Stanley 2016 (PNAS); Shen et al. 2019 (GSA Bulletin); Reichow et al. 2009 (EPSL); Elkins-Tanton et al. 2020 (Geology); Joachimski et al. 2012 (Geology); Sun et al. 2012 (Science); Penn et al. 2018 (Science); Penn and Deutsch 2022 (Science); Clarkson et al. 2015 (Science); Jurikova et al. 2020 (Nature Geoscience); Cui et al. 2021 (PNAS); Liu et al. 2023 (Science Advances); Whitney and Sidor 2020 (Communications Biology); Chen and Benton 2012 (Nature Geoscience); Fielding et al. 2019 and Nowak et al. 2019 (Nature Communications); Visscher et al. 2004 (PNAS); Benca et al. 2018 (Science Advances); Global Carbon Budget 2025; MIT News, UW News, GFZ press pages.

Tasveerein aur footage: 25 crore saal pehle ki asli footage maujood nahi hoti, isliye screen par dikhne wali zyada tar clips aur photos AAJ ki hain (stand-in) aur har jagah chip me likha hai. Public domain / free licence sources: NASA (Scientific Visualization Studio, ISS, Earth Observatory), NOAA (Ocean Exploration, Sanctuaries, Coral Reef Watch, CIRA), USGS (Hawaiian Volcano Observatory), USDA Forest Service, National Park Service, Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, OVSICORI-UNA (Poas volcano webcam), Smithsonian Open Access (CC0), Wikimedia Commons public domain / CC0 files (credits in the video chips; photographers include Gary Todd, Mostafameraji, Thomas Farley), Natural Earth (map data), aur Pixabay Content Licence (free commercial use) ki photos.

AI reconstruction: Permian ke jaanwar (Gorgonopsian, Lystrosaurus, shuruaati mammal, trilobite), purane jungle aur samundar ke kai drishya AI se bane reconstruction hain, screen par 'AI reconstruction' likha hai. Ye asli footage nahi hai. Pangaea aur India ka nakshe ka hissa hamara simplified (approximate) model hai.

Ye video sirf padhi hui studies par based hai. Naye research se numbers badal sakte hain.

Possibilities: Kya ho sakta hai? Subscribe karke agla video na chhodein.
